name: OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.noise_sum
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
          sigma →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
          (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
            ∀ (b m : ℕ),
              b ≤ m →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun ω =>
                      ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico b m,
                            (g (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j))
                                (ξ j ω) -
                              gradient f
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j)))‖ ^
                        2)
                    ↑P ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                      ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico b m,
                            (g (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j))
                                (ξ j ω) -
                              gradient f
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j)))‖ ^
                        2 ∂↑P ≤
                    (↑m - ↑b) * sigma ^ 2
